title: Full AES-256 chosen-key multicollision supporting trail with 36 state and 5 schedule active S-boxes, BKN 2009

target.description: One specified full-round AES-256 differential trail in Table2, including whitening and the actual nonlinear AES-256 key schedule, with DeltaP=0. This property is not the full q-multicollision construction and not a universal minimum bound.

setting.key_relation: A selected key pair K and K XOR DeltaK with DeltaK specified by Table2 K^0,K^1 differences; all five active key-schedule S-box conditions are imposed.
setting.key_population: Chosen related keys satisfying the fixed differential trail; not an arbitrary secret-key claim.
setting.plaintext_model: Equal chosen plaintexts in the two executions (DeltaP=0); output difference is 01 in all four bytes of row0 and zero elsewhere.
assumptions: Only the stated fixed trail is represented; multicollision multiplicity q and ideal-cipher distinguishing experiment remain separately unstructured.
Local S-box compatibility does not on its own prove joint global realizability or TA output independence.

property.statement: The specified full14-round equal-plaintext trail has 36 active state S-boxes and five active key-schedule S-boxes. TA fixes30 active inputs and leaves11 unhandled transitions with nominal product2^-67.
property.quantifier: Existential author-reported fixed differential trail; no all-key statement, minimum-active-S-box theorem, or independent attack-success claim is asserted.
property.scope: Table2 full AES-256 multicollision trail, DeltaP=0 and the source fixed nonzero key/output differences. The Davies-Meyer first-round variant is a separate target experiment.

parameters.name: state_active
parameters.meaning: State active S-box counts byround are16,5,2,2,1,1,4,0,2,0,2,0,1,0.

parameters.name: schedule_active
parameters.meaning: Five active key-schedule S-box transitions have DDT count2.

parameters.name: fixed_active
parameters.meaning: All25 active state S-boxes in rounds1–4 plus five schedule S-box inputs are fixed by the source TA.

parameters.name: free_bytes
parameters.meaning: Source TA returns18 free bytes:11 in subkeys and7 in state variables.

parameters.name: residual_exponent
parameters.meaning: Eleven unsolved transitions in rounds5–14 include10 count4 transitions and1 count2 transition.

validation.description: Original source trail, AppendixA constants and reported probability analysis checked. Independent finite test recomputes the AES S-box DDT, all state linear layers and final whitening, and the key-difference recurrence. It establishes local compatibility and arithmetic only; the full attack, global trail/TA distribution and numerical success remain unreproduced.

success.description: Supporting specified-trail property; its S-box transition product is not a numerical completed-attack success probability.

evidence.locator: PDF9–10 / printed pp.239–240 Section2.2; PDF18–19 / printed pp.248–249 Table2 and Figure5.
evidence.interpretation: Source constants are preserved as one explicit supporting trail, separate from a completed recovery or a q-multicollision target.

limitations: This is one explicit supporting trail, not a globally optimal or minimum-active-S-box theorem.
Local DDT compatibility and linear-layer checks do not establish joint realizability, TA independence, or a completed attack.
Source-native nominal products and reported experiments are not promoted to independently proved end-to-end probabilities.
